description: Does live AIS tracking actually work at this location? Listens at a point and reports whether any community receiver covers it, so you can tell the difference between "no ships here" and "no receivers here" before trusting a zero. Use this whenever a vessel search comes back empty, and always before treating an empty result as evidence that shipping has stopped.

radius_km.description: Radius to test around the point in km (default 150)

name: ais_coverage_check
